 Silver Futures Decline to Rs 1.92 Lakh/kg
 By Rediff Money Desk , New Delhi 
 1 Minute Read Listen to Article 
 Share:     
 Oct 27, 2026 13:24
 x 
 Silver futures prices fell by Rs 3,743 to Rs 1,92,050 per kg on MCX due to participant sell-off. Global silver also saw a 2.14% decline. Photograph: Amr Abdallah Dalsh/Reuters Key Points
 Silver futures prices declined by Rs 3,743 to Rs 1,92,050 per kg.
 The decline was observed in December delivery contracts on the Multi Commodity Exchange.
 Analysts attributed the fall to a sell-off by market participants.
 Globally, silver prices also dropped by 2.14% to USD 52.81 per ounce.
 New Delhi, Oct 27 (PTI) Silver prices on Tuesday fell by Rs 3,743 to Rs 1,92,050 per kilogram in futures trade as participants reduced their bets.
On the Multi Commodity Exchange, silver contracts for December delivery declined by Rs 3,743, or 1.91 per cent, to Rs 1,92,050 per kg in a business turnover of 3,482 lots.
 Analysts said a sell-off by participants mainly weighed on silver prices.
 Globally, the white metal was trading 2.14 per cent down at USD 52.81 per ounce in New York. -->

 New Delhi, Oct 27 (PTI) Silver prices on Tuesday fell by Rs 3,743 to Rs 1,92,050 per kilogram in futures trade as participants reduced their bets.
On the Multi Commodity Exchange, silver contracts for December delivery declined by Rs 3,743, or 1.91 per cent, to Rs 1,92,050 per kg in a business turnover of 3,482 lots.
 Analysts said a sell-off by participants mainly weighed on silver prices.
 Globally, the white metal was trading 2.14 per cent down at USD 52.81 per ounce in New York.
